description: This file defines the `dm_radio_cap_list_t` class, which manages a list of radio capabilities for a wireless mesh system, including functions for initialization, traversal, database synchronization, configuration, and updates.

classes.name: dm_radio_cap_list_t
classes.description: A class to manage a list of radio capabilities, including initialization, traversal, database synchronization, and configuration functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the radio capability list, setting up necessary data structures and state.

methods.name: dm_radio_cap_t * get_first()
methods.description: Retrieves the first radio capability from the list.

methods.name: dm_radio_cap_t * get_next(dm_radio_cap_t * radio_cap)
methods.description: Retrieves the next radio capability after a given one.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Determines the DM orchestration type based on database client and radio capabilities.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the radio capability list based on the specified operation.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes or clears the entire radio capability list.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Initializes the infrastructure for managing the radio capability list table.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Initializes the columns required for the radio capability list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the database with the current radio capabilities and context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Performs a database update operation with given data and operation type.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database with a provided key.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters on the database based on a JSON object.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings from a JSON object.
